items.text: I have read the information about the study and had the opportunity to ask questions.
I agree that my in-game actions, timings and interface use are recorded under a pseudonymous code.
I agree that my answers to the short background questionnaire are stored under the same code.

[Placeholder: approved wording] I agree that my microphone records my voice, and what is said around me, from the microphone check until the end of the game, and that the recordings are stored encrypted under my code.
I understand that participation is voluntary and that I can stop at any moment without giving a reason.
I agree that my pseudonymised data may be reused in future research by the same research group. (optional)
